title: Reed Noctilucence
description: A song in five lets the melody lean past the accompaniment. Its six-bar statements retain the same outline while the supporting pulse changes from three-plus-two to two-plus-three, then becomes a slow descending ground. Chromatic neighbours lead to one brief, luminous crest before the last return settles into a soft minor close.
technical_note: Hear the five beats as a flexible long breath. Keep the melody continuous when the accompaniment changes grouping. The sixteenth-note turns are written explicitly; place the returning tune quietly above the falling bass.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.
